title: angostura obovata
intro: Angostura obovata, commonly known as Angostura, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Angostura include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimalarial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain, fever, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Angostura include xanthones and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
